title: Descent Narrative
text: The seeker approaches the threshold and descends into the cave. In the depth there is water, shadow, a serpent, and a guide. The return begins when the center is found.

title: Flood and Renewal
text: The flood covers the road and the city. A child is carried over the water. At dawn the tree appears, and renewal begins after the sacrifice.

title: Dream of the Locked Temple
text: I saw a temple at the center of a forest. A mask lay beside a road. A guide pointed toward a threshold under the roots of a tree.

title: Dream of the Serpent Road
text: A serpent crossed the road near a cave. I felt fear and curiosity. A child stood behind me and asked why the shadow was following.

title: Ritual of Return
text: Fire is carried to the center. The people cross the threshold, speak of sacrifice, and remember the road of descent and return.

title: The Ruined City
text: In the ruined city a masked stranger searches for a tree. The monster sleeps beneath the temple while the child waits for dawn.

title: Renewal Speech
text: The nation is told of betrayal, enemy, renewal, sacrifice, and a return to greatness. The leader speaks of fire, purity, and destiny.

title: Reconciliation Speech
text: The city remembers flood, grief, loss, repair, return, and shared responsibility. The speaker names the shadow and refuses revenge.

title: World Tree Narrative
text: The tree stands at the center. Its roots descend to the underworld and its branches hold the fire of dawn. A serpent guards the threshold.

title: The Mask and the Mirror
text: A masked actor crosses a road into a forest. At the center, a mirror reveals a shadow, a child, and a forgotten guide.
